facts.fact: Sandy 白天把梦中恶魔自我说服成荣格式的象征，并随身带着一副塔罗牌
facts.anchor: the devil in Sandy’s dream wouldn’t have been the literal, actual devil—it was obviously some sort of symbolic representation

facts.fact: 起居室的电视是老式显像管机，只有 UHF/VHF 两个旋钮，要 Dad 帮忙才开机
facts.anchor: it was an old-fashioned cathode ray contraption with two dials labeled UHF and VHF

facts.fact: 停格动画里戴纸单片镜的狐狸被 Sandy 觉得像市长的拙劣漫画像
facts.anchor: it kind of made the fox look a little bit like a bad caricature of the lord mayor

facts.fact: 家宴上市长拿「发怒的胡萝卜」打趣不吃肉的 Sandy，全桌只得陪笑
facts.anchor: you certainly wouldn’t want to run afoul of some irate carrot either, now would you?

facts.fact: 市长夫人 Molly 不停劝已经饱到极点的 Jessica 吃 Tigglestide 造型饼干
facts.anchor: the lord mayor’s wife would not stop offering her frosted Tigglestide cookies baked into various amusing shapes

facts.fact: Molly 等男士们聊开才耳语：Round Robin 是 Hasenhurst 的精灵，Tigglestide 前夜降临、偏爱井然有序的人家
facts.anchor: Round Robin is the spirit of Hasenhurst. He comes on Tigglestide Eve, and he brings luck and prosperity to those whom he favors.

facts.fact: 育儿室里平时守规矩的 Percival 说破 Round Robin 的年例：奖赏对的人、矫正错的人
facts.anchor: Every year, on Tigglestide, he comes to reward the right sort of people and set right the wrong sort of people.

facts.fact: 临别时 Percival 堵住 Sandy 补一句「你还没读第三张牌」，又警告他不奖励错的人；Sandy 想起梦中长耳黄眼的身影
facts.anchor: You never read the third card.
